custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a Part Library entry with no part behind it for this test, entry A: create a part at the test location, then delete it, so its entry stays with "Total parts" 0.
  • Use two descriptions that differ from each other and from entry A's, description 1 and description 2.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425618-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425618-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Entry A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Its detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 0.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • The Description field shows description 1.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the detail page shows description 1: an entry with nothing behind it can be edited.

Step 6:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 7:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 8:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens.

Step 9:

  • Description shows description 2.

Step 10:

  • Part Number shows entry A's number.

Step 11:

  • Category shows the category you picked.

Step 12:

  • Cost shows 10.00.

Step 13:

  • The part is saved and linked to entry A: a green message reads "Part created. Linked to" with entry A's number, "in the Part Library. Its description" with description 1 in quotation marks, and "was kept."

Step 14:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 15:

  • Still exactly one entry is listed for entry A's number: no second entry was made.

Step 16:

  • The detail page keeps description 1 and now shows "Total parts" 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S11-E2: “An entry with no inventory part behind it can still be edited from its detail page, and is the entry a new part links to when its number is typed exactly (S7-R5).”
  • S7-R5: “If exactly one entry matches, the new part is linked to that entry.”
  • S7-R6: “A linked entry keeps its own description. The description typed in the dialog does not change it.”
  • S7-R9: “When the part was linked to an existing entry whose description differs from the one typed, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces before and after, the system shows "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." For example: "Part created. Linked to N68SL-356 in the Part Library. Its description "BRAKE PAD" was kept."”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • QA lead, 9 Oct 2026, set-up answer 4: “Yes after deleting the inventory part from parts -> Inventory you can still locate its catalogue entry from parts catalog”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "1.4 Saved and linked to the Part Library entry", "7.2 An entry opens its detail page". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-04-p1-4-linked-toast.png
  • library-02-p7-2-entry-detail.png

The design's own words:

  • “Exactly one Part Library entry has the number typed, so the new part links to it (S7-R4, S7-R5). The entry keeps its own description (S7-R6). The descriptions differ, so the toast reads: "Part created. Linked to F40010212 in the Part Library. Its description "Slack Adjuster" was kept." (S7-R9). There is no toast when they match, or when a new entry is created (S7-R10).”
